subject.title: /new and /reset should support @agent targeting in multi-agent channels

question: What should the supported `/new` and `/reset` target contract be in shared multi-agent channels?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but target syntax, no-target defaults, prompt versus fail-closed behavior, and cross-agent authorization are product/security policy decisions rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Require or prompt for explicit target
options.body: Make destructive commands in ambiguous multi-agent channels require a clear target or return an in-product target prompt before resetting any session.

options.title: Use current route as smart default
options.body: Continue resetting the resolved route by default and add optional explicit targeting only when users provide a supported target form.

options.title: Leave command behavior unchanged
options.body: Keep relying on channel isolation and route bindings, leaving shared-channel multi-agent destructive commands unsupported.

recommendation.title: Require or prompt for explicit target
recommendation.body: Make destructive commands in ambiguous multi-agent channels require a clear target or return an in-product target prompt before resetting any session.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available provenance points to shared native-command and reset/session routing work in the affected files.
